source.title: Feeding friend and foe: ample pollen mitigates the effects of pollen theft for a gynodioecious plant, Polemonium foliosissimum (Polemoniaceae)
source.study_level: single-source ecological experiment with multiple endpoints, not a direct BALANCE architecture worldline

pollen_remaining_on_anthers_after_one_vi.warning: Remaining pollen is not removed pollen; source initial donor pollen stock is not verified equal for each visitor treatment

pollen_deposited_on_stigma_per_single_vi.warning: Numeric deposition difference was not significant; pollen receipt is not viable paternity

neighbourhood_pollen_manipulation.experimental_intervention: Approximately half the anthers removed from hermaphrodites in designated neighbourhoods, not an exactly measured 50 percent of pollination-available pollen
neighbourhood_pollen_manipulation.source_pollen_receipt_result: Some recipient pollen-load reductions, varying by year and plant sexual form
neighbourhood_pollen_manipulation.reproductive_output_result: Reduction in neighbourhood anther availability did not detectably exacerbate pollen limitation of fruit or seed production
neighbourhood_pollen_manipulation.warning: Non-detection does not prove zero effect or causal equivalence

hand_supplementation_2016.warning: Cannot combine hand-pollination and anther-reduction summaries to estimate an unreported source-pollen by visitation-capacity interaction

model_link.candidate_mechanism: Pollen supply and effective visitation opportunities can be separate constraints on realized seed production
model_link.causal_gate_not_measured: No matched intervention that sets number/quality of effective pollinator visits while independently manipulating donor pollen stock
model_link.source_timing_not_measured: No controlled visitor-order swap with donor pollen release schedule
do_not_infer: a new independent BALANCE V4 biological response
an experimentally measured effect of different architecture costs
an actual odds ratio or pollen-conservation parameter for the synthetic model
